answer: The mechanism I find most convincing: each epoch, validators are drawn into grading panels by verifiable random rotation, so no jury ever persists. Like a tide reshaping an island, every rotation scatters fixed coalitions back onto the anonymous ledge of the pool. To attack, a sybil must warm thousands of honest-looking identities with real work and stake, then still beat the geometrically shrinking odds that enough colluders share one panel. Expected payout per puppet falls below its staking cost, so fake identity stops paying.
